data.name: OrderConfirmed.Body
data.value:
Hello {0},
Your order {1} is confirmed. The stock is reserved and the payment is taken. The total is EUR {2:N2}.
Thank you for ordering at the Cat bookshop.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the customer, {1} is the order number, {2} is the total in euro.

data.name: OrderConfirmed.UnnamedCustomer
data.comment: Used as {0} of OrderConfirmed.Body when the customer has no name.

data.name: StockDrop.Body
data.value:
Hello,
The stock of ISBN {0} in warehouse {1} dropped to {2}. The limit is {3}.
Please order more copies.
data.comment: {0} is the ISBN, {1} is the warehouse number, {2} is the new quantity, {3} is the limit.

data.name: LowStockReport.Subject.One
data.comment: The subject of a report with one line.

data.name: LowStockReport.Subject.Many
data.comment: The subject of a report with more lines. {0} is the number of lines.

data.name: LowStockReport.Body
data.value:
Hello,
These stock items are below the limit of {0}:
{1}
Please order more copies.
data.comment: {0} is the limit, {1} is the list of lines, one LowStockReport.Line for each item.

data.name: LowStockReport.Line
data.comment: One line of the list. {0} is the ISBN, {1} is the name of the warehouse, {2} is the quantity on hand.
